description: Finds portals (doors) by location or name. Portal names are site codes (e.g. 01OF05A), so this also searches each portal's reader names and reader descriptions (e.g. 'WORKSHOP TO MAINTENANCE OFFICE'). Case-insensitive; a portal matches when every whitespace-separated term appears in its name, a reader name, or a reader description. Reads every page of GetPortals and GetReaders and joins them by READERKEY. The result also lists portals with no reader description, which can only match by name.

query.description: Required. Search terms, e.g. "maintenance office", "electrical closet", or "01OF05".

name: find_portals
